# waroom_on_call_team (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom on-call team. Look it up by either `uuid` or `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an on-call team by name
data "waroom_on_call_team" "example" {
  name = "SRE"
}

# Or by UUID
data "waroom_on_call_team" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the on-call team to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set. It is an error if no team or more than one team has this name.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the on-call team to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) The color of the on-call team, as a 6-digit hex code without `#` (e.g. `FF0000`).
- `id` (String) On-call team ID. This is an alias for `uuid`.
